reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16827. Abstract summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced the automation of software engineering tasks. One prominent example is code generation, where an LLM produces code in a specified programming language based on a natural language description. Most research in this area has focused on high-resource languages, such as Python Out of scope: Low-resource code generation capability/training study.
title: No Resource, No Benchmarks, No Problem? Evaluating and Improving LLMs for Code Generation in No-Resource Languages
